strategy.summary: cartTotal(items, {coupon}) in src/cart.js prices a cart: bulk 10% off at the item-count threshold, SAVE5 coupon after it (floored at $0), unknown coupons throw (exact, case-sensitive match), $4.99 shipping below $50 of discounted goods, empty cart free. Unit tests in Vitest prove each rule and its boundaries. bulkDiscount uses `> BULK_THRESHOLD`, so exactly 10 items get no discount, against AC1; that case is an expected failure with a recorded defect. Revision 2 adds two cases from PR review: the coupon taking goods below $50 brings shipping back, and lower-case save5 is refused.
inScope: cartTotal, bulkDiscount behaviour in src/cart.js via its exported API
outOfScope: UI/checkout pages (none exist in the repo)
assumptions: Shipping still applies when a coupon brings goods to $0 on a non-empty cart (AC3: goods under $50 pay $4.99).
Coupon codes are matched exactly (case-sensitive), as the code does and the PR reviewer asked to pin.
Tests go in test/cart-total.test.js beside test/cart.test.js, importing from ../src/cart.js like it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart with 10 or more items in total (sum of line quantities) gets 10% off its subtotal; fewer than 10 gets none.
Coupon SAVE5 takes $5 off after the bulk discount, goods never below $0; any other coupon code is refused with an error.
Shipping is free when goods after discounts are $50 or more, otherwise $4.99; an empty cart costs $0.

review.standard: Repo-wide files you may change / match the repo's conventions (the repo uses npm: CI runs `npm install` and `npm test`)
review.summary: The change adds empty pnpm-lock.yaml and yarn.lock files to an npm project that the ticket's tests don't need.
review.failureScenario: The repo installs with npm (.github/workflows/ci.yml runs `npm install --no-audit --no-fund`; there's no packageManager field). If the PR merges with an empty pnpm-lock.yaml and an empty yarn.lock (same problem at yarn.lock line 1), tools that pick a package manager from the lockfile (corepack-aware scripts, `ni`, Renovate, hosting platforms) will choose pnpm or yarn and get an empty or invalid lockfile. For example, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` fails, or the tool resolves fresh versions while ignoring npm. The tests prove the same either way, so this is a cleanup. Delete both files from the change.

feedback.author: gregoryduckworth
feedback.body:
Thanks, this mostly looks good. Three points before it can go in:

1. Shipping coming back after the coupon isn't covered. The $50 case lands exactly on the threshold, but nothing checks that SAVE5 can take the goods from above $50 to below it, so shipping is charged again (for example, one $54.99 item with SAVE5 should cost $54.98). Please add that case.
2. AC2 says any other coupon code is refused, but nothing pins whether the match is case-sensitive. Please add a case showing that a lower-case `save5` is refused.
3. Question, no change needed unless you think one is: why `it.fails` for the exactly-10-items defect rather than leaving a plain failing test?
